# OCSP freshness vectors for a Good response that carries NO nextUpdate (RFC 6960 4.2.2.1:
# the responder then promises newer information at any time, so the response may be accepted
# inline within a bounded age but never settles revocation). EC P-256 ca_cert (anchor, also
# the OCSP signer) -> leaf_cert (serial 0x1001, SAN=localhost, EKU serverAuth, AIA OCSP
# http://ocsp.tlslib.test/). Validity 2020-01-01..2099-12-31.
#   ocsp_good_nonext   - status good, thisUpdate only (no -ndays/-nmin): This Update: Sep 25 00:12:27 2026 GMT
#   ocsp_good_withnext - same, plus nextUpdate = thisUpdate + 26000 days
# Tests read thisUpdate back from the parsed response and derive the clock from it.
# Generated with OpenSSL 4.0.1 (NB=20200101000000Z, NA=20991231000000Z):
#   openssl ecparam -name prime256v1 -genkey -noout -out ca.key
#   openssl req -new -x509 -key ca.key -sha256 -subj "/CN=TlsLib NoNextUpdate CA" -set_serial 1 -not_before NB -not_after NA -out ca.pem
#   openssl ecparam -name prime256v1 -genkey -noout -out leaf.key
#   openssl req -new -key leaf.key -subj "/CN=localhost" -out leaf.csr
#   openssl x509 -req -in leaf.csr -CA ca.pem -CAkey ca.key -set_serial 0x1001 -sha256 -not_before NB -not_after NA -extfile leaf.ext -out leaf.pem
#     leaf.ext: basicConstraints=CA:false / keyUsage=critical,digitalSignature / extendedKeyUsage=serverAuth /
#               subjectAltName=DNS:localhost / authorityInfoAccess=OCSP;URI:http://ocsp.tlslib.test/ /
#               subjectKeyIdentifier=hash / authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid
#   printf 'V\t20991231000000Z\t\t1001\tunknown\t/CN=localhost\n' > index.txt
#   openssl ocsp -issuer ca.pem -cert leaf.pem -no_nonce -reqout req.der
#   openssl ocsp -index index.txt -CA ca.pem -rsigner ca.pem -rkey ca.key -reqin req.der -respout ocsp_good_nonext.der
#   openssl ocsp -index index.txt -CA ca.pem -rsigner ca.pem -rkey ca.key -reqin req.der -ndays 26000 -respout ocsp_good_withnext.der
#   openssl x509 -in X.pem -outform DER | xxd -p   (each *_cert field)
#   openssl pkey -in X.key -outform DER | xxd -p   (PKCS#8 DER, each *_key field)
#   xxd -p X.der                                   (each ocsp_* field)
